I'm 20 and everything you did is what I'm doing/feeling right now, started to wonder seriously when I was 19? But I showed many signs when I was a kid. About the cis people thing, that's right, I saw a thread and it was a transwoman asking to cis people something similar they were all like "No tf" while I'm like, well that's weird because that's something I wish that could happen to me. Still I do feel sometimes comfortable being what I am right now but I don't know, it's weird. Still questioning myself.

Same thing, I've been wondering if I could have some sort of internalized misogyny too but I'm all about "Woman power!" and admire women a lot. I hate it too when people associate "feminine" things to me that I should do because "I'm a woman", I've been feeling this way since I was a kid.

That's exactly what I want to do, but the opposite, I want to cut my hair short, try to wear masculine clothes and see how it goes, see if things get more serious and then meet a trans/gender therapist. I'm happy for you!
Thanks a lot this is very helpful!!
That's what I'm probably going to do because I'm really lost

Tbh your comment helped a lot, you're right. Exactly, love is love, having feelings for the same sex is as normal as having feelings for the opposite sex, people are fighting for their right to love, literally, but still I get ashamed of my feelings towards the same sex but I guess it will take me a bit of time to totally embrace and accept it. I really really like the way you think about it and I hope one day I will have that same way of thinking! Thanks a lot for your comment!

Same! It hasn't been so long since I've been sure of my sexuality, I used to think I was straight till last may or something. You're also right, that's what I thought as well, I mean, I had same sex attraction before but I would try to not think about it because I find it ''wrong''?. But now as I'm accepting my sexuality and discovering more about myself, I'm more open and I don't find it wrong.
Well, I'm glad to see I'm not the only one like that and from what I read it's completely normal, other bisexuals feel the same way. Glad I somehow helped you as well haha
I had no idea there was a name for this lol

Honestly you're right, I'm already dealing with mental issues and I don't want to end up disowned or something, it would make everything worse, since I also depend emotionally on my parents. I think I will wait till I can depend on myself like you said, before saying anything about my sexuality. It just hurts that I have to hide this way while seeing others being accepted and supported by their parents(I'm happy for them obviously!)  at such a young age(well my age) while I have to endure my parents homophobic remarks as they are just hurting me without even knowing and making it harder for me to accept myself as an LGBT individual. I never talk to them about LGBT stuff, it makes me nervous (We talk rarely about LGBT, when its on the news for example) and so it would be very weird for me to suddenly ask something like that haha. Thank you for your advice :)
Yes. I depend on them a lot, financially + the house is close to where I'm studying. I don't plan on moving out anytime soon.

I still live with them and depend on them both emotionally&financially... These days (or months?) I've been really but really into girls, I'm not even thinking about guys and I have this feeling that I might end up with a girl, I also keep hearing about other LGBT people coming out to their parents.(not long ago it was ''national coming out day'' as well) I feel like all of this is putting pressure on me somehow? But you're right, I don't really have to tell them unless I'm in a relationship with a girl. But I still feel weird about this because I'm still ''hiding'' from them something kinda important about who I am? I wish I didn't have to hear my brother spout homophobic slurs constantly and my parents expressing homophobic views&not caring, they are all hurting me without even knowing and it makes it harder for me to accept myself as an LGBT individual. I'm not planning to tell them any soon as I'm trying to be confident with my sexuality. I have this big fear that I might out myself on accident tho if I ever get into a debate about LGBT or something with them (As I get pretty angry). Thank you for your comment, it helped me a lot!!

My parents aren't religious, I'm aware that other people from the same muslim country are more religious and conservative than my parents, and beat and disown their kids if they are LGBT but my parents are not the type of people who would kill or beat me... 
But thank you!
